preview.text: Bahrain and Kuwait meet in a T20 match at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval, where they have played 13 recorded T20 matches with Bahrain winning 3 and Kuwait winning 10. Bahrain won the toss and chose to bowl first. The usual first-innings score in the 10 recorded T20 matches at this venue is 125, while the forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 95 per cent chance of rain and about 32 degrees.

summary.text: Bahrain won the match by 6 wickets after chasing down a target of 188-7, where Muhammad Umar top-scored with 78 off 38 balls and Ali Dawood took 3 for 14. In reply, Bahrain posted 189-4 thanks to Asif Ali (c) who scored 89 off 48 balls, while Adnan Idrees finished with bowling figures of 2 for 23.
